config.name: AskHarbor
config.greeting: Hi! What can I help you with?

answers.label: How do I get started?
answers.answer: Add the AskHarbor script before your closing body tag and provide your server URL and bot ID.

answers.label: What can this chatbot do?
answers.answer: This version provides guided answers from your server. You choose a question and receive a predefined answer with any follow up choices.

answers.label: How can I contact support?
answers.answer: Email your support team at support@example.com.

answers.label: Show installation details
answers.answer: Serve the compiled widget, then set data-api-url and data-bot-id on the script element.

answers.label: Can I customize it?
answers.answer: Yes. Bot name, greeting, launcher label, color, questions, and answers all come from the server.
